patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive product imagery dominates hero and key showcase sections, often with dark, rich backgrounds to highlight the product.
Elegant serif typography is used for primary headings and product titles, contrasting with clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A sophisticated dark palette (deep blues, blacks, dark greys) serves as a backdrop, allowing product photography and subtle gold accents to stand out.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the initial full-bleed hero image scrolls up and out of view to reveal subsequent content.
Product collections are presented in horizontal carousels, allowing users to browse multiple items within a dedicated section.

technique_notes: The main navigation is implemented as a sticky header, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.
The hero section features a full-bleed image or video (video-hero detected) that scrolls out of view, revealing the content below without complex parallax layering.
Product showcases utilize a horizontal carousel system (swiper detected) to display multiple items in a scrollable format within a single section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body text) are paired with smaller, highly legible sans-serif body text; some labels use uppercase sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a luxurious and uncrowded feel.

standout: This site stands out for its sophisticated, dark-themed presentation that leverages full-bleed, high-quality product photography to create an immersive and luxurious experience. The elegant serif typography for headings, combined with the deep color palette, effectively communicates exclusivity and heritage.
